about_short_description.short_description: Ittihad is an investment firm that operates and offers industrial, construction, healthcare, environmental energy and utility services.

product.name: Investment and Portfolio Management
product.description: Alternative investment services focused on developing, managing, and operating a diversified portfolio across industrial, infrastructure, healthcare, and environmental services sectors.

product.name: Consumer Goods Manufacturing
product.description: Manufacturing of printing and writing paper, tissue paper, and chemicals used in detergent and personal care products.

product.name: Infrastructure and Building Materials Manufacturing
product.description: Manufacturing of copper rods, straight steel bars, cut and bend steel, and cementitious materials for infrastructure and construction applications.

product.name: Infrastructure Network Operation and Maintenance
product.description: Operation and maintenance services for infrastructure networks, supporting the ongoing performance and upkeep of public and private infrastructure assets.

product.name: Wastewater and Sewage Treatment Services
product.description: Procurement, operation, maintenance, and management services for wastewater treatment plants, sewage networks, and sewage treatment plants.

product.name: Hospital Radiology Department Services
product.description: Procurement, maintenance, and operation of radiology departments in government-owned hospitals, including turnkey radiology solutions for healthcare facilities.
